notes.title: v0.8 Feature Update Released
notes.notes:
After an incredible amount of work, Invasion Phoenix v0.8 has now been released!

Quick summary of updates:
- ALL units for ALL factions now in and working
- Added weather system
- Added 4 new maps to Custom Match
- Updated all custom match maps
- Revamped entire art style, now using 4k world tile sheet
- Created 2-map tutorial mode
- Ludicrous amount of bug fixes
- Tons of preparatory work on campaign mode

Please report any and all bugs and weirdness you see. If you have any feedback, I'd love to hear it!

We are now full speed ahead on campaign mode! Stay tuned for more!
